name: Fallback Media
description: Adds a 'Rendered entity (with fallback)' field formatter for media entity-reference fields that renders an admin-configured fallback media item when the field is empty.
project_description: Fallback Media lets a site show a default media item wherever a media entity-reference field is left empty. It ships one config entity, 'fallback_entity' (class Drupal\fallback_media\Entity\FallbackEntity, config_prefix fallback_entity), each instance of which stores a label plus the target media id of a chosen fallback media item; instances are managed through admin CRUD routes generated by FallbackEntityHtmlRouteProvider (extends core AdminHtmlRouteProvider) under /admin/structure/fallback_entity, gated by the entity's admin_permission 'administer site configuration', with add/edit handled by FallbackEntityForm (EntityForm, media entity_autocomplete) and delete by FallbackEntityDeleteForm (EntityConfirmFormBase). It also ships one field formatter plugin, EntityReferenceFallbackFormatter (id entity_reference_entity_fallback, 'Rendered entity (with fallback)'), which extends core EntityReferenceEntityFormatter and is applicable only to entity_reference fields whose target_type is 'media'; when the field has values it defers to the core rendered-entity formatter, and when the field is empty it loads and renders the media item named by the selected fallback_entity in the configured view mode. Depends only on core Media; provides no routes/permissions/services beyond the entity handlers, no Drush, and no external HTTP.
